notes: neither fuses the waw with the present lo' and heads on the negative; nor rests on the waw alone because the negative is gapped in that line (rule 35).
of in drink of the water is given to the verb under rule 44, since the Hebrew object is bare.
derekh ha-melekh is the possessive case of rule 29: the article takes the the standing before king's, and derekh keeps highway together with the along its adverbial accusative licenses (rule 33).
